adjudication: astra-classscope-02 (2026-09-12T00:01:50+08:00): the variant finding is ACCEPTED and new class ids are REJECTED pending Human PI. Every non-frozen reading is registered here as a VARIANT of a frozen parent class, never as a class id.
purpose: Every class and registered variant the formulation group knows about, with the exact delta from its frozen parent class, the strength relation, and the reason it must not be conflated. No truth claim is made about any class or variant.
rule: a claim must cite either the exact class_id of a frozen parent class, or the (parent_class, variant_id) pair of a registered variant; citing a variant as a class, or a class result as a variant, is class leakage
class_id_rule: only the four frozen class ids may appear in any class_ids field: AF-WCC-VAC-GEN, AF-SCC-C2-VAC-GEN, AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN, AF-WCC-SCALAR-SPH. Variant ids (SET, CH, H2LOC, TWOSIDED, DISTRIBUTIONAL, L2CONN, LIP) are NOT class ids and must never appear in a class_ids field.

parent_classes.role: base class: I+ complete and no future-incomplete causal geodesic visible from I+ (single-q TAIL predicate)
base class: no proper FUTURE extension with g' in C2 and Ric(g')=0
base class: no proper FUTURE extension with g' merely continuous and nondegenerate; no equation required. STRONGER than AF-SCC-C2-VAC-GEN (E_C2 is a subset of E_C0)
frozen declared class: Einstein-massless-scalar-field system, spherical symmetry, WCC conclusion; genericity notion unresolved; no schema node exists

variants.definition: replaces the single-q tail visibility predicate by the SET-based condition: a future-inextendible causal geodesic gamma is visible from I+ iff gamma([0,T)) is contained in the union of J^-(q) over all q in I+ (intersected with M), i.e. iff gamma lies in J^-(I+) as a set.
variants.strength: strictly STRONGER than AF-WCC-VAC-GEN: gamma not contained in the union J^-(I+) implies no single past J^-(q) contains a tail of gamma, but not conversely
variants.why_separate: the declared F0 taxonomy used this set-based form before the 2026-09-12 adjudication; F1 now carries ONE canonical predicate (single-q tail) and this reading is kept as a variant so neither direction is silently conflated
variants.falsifier: show the two forms equivalent, e.g. that every incomplete geodesic contained in the union has a tail inside J^-(q) for some single q; then variant SET collapses and divergence D1 is cleared by proof rather than by wording

variants.definition: horizon-localized C0 reading: the maximal development is inextendible as a continuous Lorentzian manifold ACROSS ITS CAUCHY HORIZON, rather than at any future boundary.
variants.strength: strictly WEAKER than AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN (a subset of extensions suffices to refute it)
variants.why_separate: L1's verified D-002 records the C0 formulation in this form, and L1's conditional refutation T-301 (interior data, conditional on Kerr exterior stability; antecedent a 2026 preprint per T-515/T-528) binds THIS variant, not the frozen broad class
variants.falsifier: show that every future extension of an AF development crosses a Cauchy horizon, which would make the two statements equivalent and let T-301 bear on the frozen broad class

variants.definition: as AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN but the extension must solve Ric(g')=0 in the sense of distributions.
variants.strength: strictly WEAKER than AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN (fewer admissible extensions)
variants.why_separate: the equation requirement is a frozen axis; substituting it silently would report a weaker theorem for the stronger class
variants.falsifier: exhibit a generic AF datum with a distributional-Ricci C0 extension but no bare continuous C0 extension; that shows the equation axis is material and the two must stay separate

variants.definition: extension class: Riemann tensor in L^2_loc (H2_loc).
variants.strength: between C2 and C0: WEAKER than AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN, STRONGER than AF-SCC-C2-VAC-GEN; containment E_C2 subset E_H2loc subset E_C0
variants.why_separate: the most likely scope error in the portfolio; Dafermos-Luk-type results are often stated in this class and must not be reported as C0 or C2
variants.falsifier: exhibit a generic AF datum with an H2_loc extension but no C2 extension; that shows the H2_loc class is strictly between C2 and C0 and cannot be reported as either

variants.definition: as AF-SCC-C2-VAC-GEN but forbids extensions in BOTH time directions.
variants.strength: strictly STRONGER than AF-SCC-C2-VAC-GEN; one-ended AF data can extend to the past into a white-hole region, so the frozen classes use the future direction deliberately
variants.why_separate: extension direction is a frozen axis; an earlier revision mislabelled two-sided as a weakening
variants.falsifier: exhibit an AF vacuum datum whose MGHD admits a past (white-hole) extension but no future extension; that shows two-sided is strictly stronger and the direction choice is material

variants.definition: extension class: continuous metric with Christoffel symbols in L^2_loc (the 'Christodoulou-Chrusciel version' as quoted by Costa-Girao-Natario-Silva 2018).
variants.strength: between C2 and C0: WEAKER than AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN, STRONGER than AF-SCC-C2-VAC-GEN. A C2 extension has continuous (hence L^2_loc) Christoffels, so E_C2 is a subset of E_L2conn; a bare continuous extension has no L^2 control, so E_L2conn is a subset of E_C0. Not comparable to variant H2LOC in general (connection-L^2 vs curvature-L^2 are different axes).
variants.why_separate: L1's per-class dossier (D-004) records this as a distinct literature formulation; citing an L^2-connection result as C0 or C2 would be a scope error
variants.falsifier: locate a primary text defining the Christodoulou-Chrusciel version with a different extension class, which would force a rename; or show L^2_loc-connection extensions exist for generic vacuum data (decides the version negatively)

variants.strength: between C^{1,1} and C0: E_{C^{1,1}} is a subset of E_{C^{0,1}} is a subset of E_C0; incomparable with E_H2loc and E_L2conn in general
variants.why_separate: L1's D-005 records the Lipschitz family as a separate intermediate formulation; L1's T-305 gives a conditional Lipschitz-inextendibility result (preprint, Price-law assumption, only near i+) which must not be reported as C0 or C2
variants.falsifier: show the Price-law assumption fails on an open set of data, making the conditional Lipschitz result vacuous there; or construct a Lipschitz extension of the Kerr Cauchy horizon near i+
